note: 2026-09-26 Unit 4 rebuild: new lesson from the old 4.8 split. Learn holds What time is it?, O'clock, Afternoon and Night; at is practised inside at night and at seven o'clock. Clock cards change only the hour (eleven and twelve bring the Unit 3 numbers back); Ana's 7:00 clock does not survive the 4:5 crop, so it stays out of four-picture cards.

lesson.title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Ask What time is it?, say whole-hour times, and say the afternoon and night parts of the day.
lesson.grammar_function: What time is it? It is + number + o'clock. in the morning / in the afternoon / at night; at + time.
lesson.prerequisite: 2.6-2.7 and 3.5 numbers (eleven, twelve); 4.5 in the morning; 4.5-4.6 wake up and sleep.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Ask the time and say whole-hour times and parts of the day.

items.text: It is seven o'clock in the morning.
items.es: Son las siete de la mañana.
prefer: It is seven o'clock at night.

items.text: It is three o'clock in the afternoon.
items.es: Son las tres de la tarde.
prefer: It is three o'clock in the morning.

items.text: It is nine o'clock at night.
items.es: Son las nueve de la noche.
prefer: It is nine o'clock in the morning.

items.text: I wake up at seven o'clock.
items.speaker: ana
